lines.zh: 石斧拖在地上，划出一道白痕。
lines.en: My stone axe drags along the floor, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 洞顶太低，我得弯着腰走。
lines.en: The cave roof sits low; I walk bent over.

lines.zh: 一步下去，地上的碎石都跳起来。
lines.en: One step, and the loose stones jump off the floor.

lines.zh: 雪地里我的脚印比门还宽。
lines.en: In snow, my footprints are wider than a door.

lines.zh: 我扛着树干，走起来左右撞。
lines.en: I carry a tree trunk and knock things on both sides.

lines.zh: 苔藓从我的肩膀上长出来。
lines.en: Moss grows along my shoulders.

lines.zh: 往深处走，脚下的石头越来越凉。
lines.en: Deeper in, the stone under my feet grows colder.

lines.zh: 长长的獠牙碰在一起，会发出轻响。
lines.en: My long tusks click softly when they touch.

lines.zh: 我低着头过洞口，还是擦到肩。
lines.en: I duck through the tunnel mouth and still scrape a shoulder.

lines.zh: 地下河的水只到我膝盖。
lines.en: The underground river only reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的钟乳石掰了下来。
lines.en: I snap off the stalactite blocking my way.

lines.zh: 走得慢，但我从不停下。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我坐在石头上，把斧刃磨得更钝。
lines.en: I sit on a rock and blunt my axe edge further.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声把我的呼吸放大了。
lines.en: The cave's echo makes my breathing sound huge.

lines.zh: 伤口在慢慢合，我不着急。
lines.en: The wound is closing on its own; no hurry.

lines.zh: 这堆蘑菇我留着，明天再吃。
lines.en: I'll keep this pile of mushrooms for tomorrow.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在指间转了两圈，很亮。
lines.en: An emerald turns twice between my fingers, bright.

lines.zh: 我在数洞壁上的裂缝，一共十七条。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the wall: seventeen.

lines.zh: 雪落在肩上，一会儿就化成水。
lines.en: Snow settles on my shoulder and melts to water.

lines.zh: 他们说我笨，我只是想得慢。
lines.en: They call me dull; I just think slowly.

lines.zh: 斧柄上的皮条，是我自己缠的。
lines.en: I wrapped the leather on this axe handle myself.

lines.zh: 把毛皮摊平，晾在暖石头上。
lines.en: I stretch the fur flat to dry on a warm stone.

lines.zh: 我把石头堆高，堆到能坐为止。
lines.en: I pile stones until there's enough to sit on.

lines.zh: 山里的风从洞口灌进来，很闷。
lines.en: Mountain wind pours through the cave mouth, stale and thick.

lines.zh: 我记得每一条通往深处的路。
lines.en: I remember every path that leads deeper in.

lines.zh: 獠牙有点长，啃东西不太方便。
lines.en: My tusks have grown long; eating is awkward now.

lines.zh: 我把斧子横在膝上，听洞里的水。
lines.en: I lay the axe across my knees and listen to the water.

lines.zh: 石壁上有一道新裂缝，我记下了。
lines.en: A new crack in the wall. I take note of it.

lines.zh: 我把靴子里的碎石倒出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I tip the gravel out of my boot and shake it.

lines.zh: 雪光从洞口照进来，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: Snowlight comes through the cave mouth. I squint.

lines.zh: 你比那些矿工矮一半，也细一半。
lines.en: You're half the height of a miner, and half as thick.

lines.zh: 我低下头，才看得清你的脸。
lines.en: I have to stoop to make out your face.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照得我眼睛疼。
lines.en: The torch in your hand stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 山里的东西我都认得，你是新的。
lines.en: I know everything in these mountains; you're new.

lines.zh: 你带了弓，那东西伤不到我。
lines.en: You brought a bow; that can't hurt me.

lines.zh: 我在看你腰上挂的那块铁。
lines.en: I'm looking at the iron at your belt.

lines.zh: 你把头抬得很高，我不习惯。
lines.en: You crane your head up high; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 雪原上的客人，通常不会久留。
lines.en: Guests on the snowfield usually don't stay long.

lines.zh: 我眨一次眼，你要过一会儿才眨。
lines.en: I blink once; you blink quite a while later.

lines.zh: 你把斧子握得太紧了，我看得出来。
lines.en: You're gripping that axe too tight; I can tell.

lines.zh: 别站在风口，那儿冷得厉害。
lines.en: Don't stand in the draft; it's bitter cold there.

lines.zh: 你是来挖矿的，还是走错路了？
lines.en: Are you here to mine, or did you take a wrong turn?

lines.zh: 斧子被打掉了，我弯腰去捡。
lines.en: My axe is knocked loose; I bend to pick it up.

lines.zh: 你这一下，砍在石头上一样。
lines.en: Your blow lands like hitting stone.

lines.zh: 伤口在合，可还是很沉。
lines.en: The wound is closing, but I still feel heavy.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，我懒得拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我往后退，撞塌了一段洞壁。
lines.en: I step back and knock down part of the wall.

lines.zh: 你的铁器比石头硬。
lines.en: Your iron is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记起很多年前的事。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of something from years ago.

lines.zh: 伤在肩上，我还能站着。
lines.en: It's in my shoulder; I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我坐下去，把斧子放在膝上。
lines.en: I sit down and rest the axe across my knees.

lines.zh: 别急着走，我还没跟你算完。
lines.en: Don't rush off; we're not finished.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋蘑菇，闻着不错。
lines.en: That sack of mushrooms in your hand smells fine.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都要，先给我看看。
lines.en: I want anything bright; let me see it first.

lines.zh: 你把绿宝石举高，我就跟着走。
lines.en: Hold the emerald high, and I'll follow.

lines.zh: 这块肉够我吃两顿，别拿走。
lines.en: That meat would feed me twice; don't take it.

lines.zh: 那股味道，是矿洞深处的甜味。
lines.en: That smell — the sweetness from deep in the mine.

lines.zh: 我伸手了，你别往后退。
lines.en: I'm reaching for it; don't step back.

lines.zh: 砂岩河里的蓝石头，你有吗？
lines.en: Do you have the blue stone from the sandstone river?

lines.zh: 我很久没吃过这么香的东西。
lines.en: I haven't eaten anything this good in a long while.

lines.zh: 给我一半，我就不追你。
lines.en: Give me half, and I won't chase you.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就跟一步。
lines.en: One step back from you, one step from me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我转身时没看见你，抱歉。
lines.en: I didn't see you when I turned; my fault.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲硌到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Your armor digs into my knee.

lines.zh: 我退半步，你就退了三步。
lines.en: I step back half; you step back three.

lines.zh: 洞道就这么宽，躲不开的。
lines.en: The tunnel is this wide; there's no dodging.

lines.zh: 我的石斧碰到你的盾，很响。
lines.en: My stone axe hits your shield, and it rings.

lines.zh: 你被撞得坐到地上，我没用力。
lines.en: You ended up on the ground; I barely pushed.

lines.zh: 别推我，我站不稳会压坏东西。
lines.en: Don't shove me; if I fall, things get crushed.

lines.zh: 肩碰肩，你只到我腰那里。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, you only reach my waist.

lines.zh: 下次绕着走，这条道容不下你和我。
lines.en: Go around next time; this path won't hold us both.

lines.zh: 她从雪原那边来，肩上全是白。
lines.en: She comes from the snowfield, white to the shoulders.

lines.zh: 我把最好的毛皮铺在她那边。
lines.en: I lay my best fur on her side of the cave.

lines.zh: 我们对坐着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We sit facing each other, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 她的斧比我的重，我承认。
lines.en: Her axe is heavier than mine; I admit it.

lines.zh: 洞里太挤，我把石堆挪开些。
lines.en: The cave is cramped; I shift the stone pile aside.

lines.zh: 两颗獠牙碰在一起，声音很轻。
lines.en: Our tusks touch, and the sound is very soft.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一个洞口，轮班。
lines.en: We guard the same cave mouth in shifts.

lines.zh: 她喜欢甜的蘑菇，我记得。
lines.en: She likes the sweet mushrooms; I remember.

lines.zh: 石像的事，我们都不提。
lines.en: Neither of us mentions the stone statues.

lines.zh: 有她在，洞里就不那么空。
lines.en: With her here, the cave feels less empty.

lines.zh: 这块石头能当锤子，我捡了。
lines.en: This stone will make a hammer; I take it.

lines.zh: 地上那枚绿宝石，我捏起来看。
lines.en: I pinch up the emerald from the floor to look.

lines.zh: 断掉的斧柄还能再用一年。
lines.en: This broken axe handle will last another year.

lines.zh: 我把蘑菇一把抓进皮袋。
lines.en: I scoop the mushrooms into my hide bag.

lines.zh: 这块骨头适合做獠牙的套子。
lines.en: This bone would make a good cap for a tusk.

lines.zh: 我把碎石扫到一边，腾出地方。
lines.en: I sweep the rubble aside to make room.

lines.zh: 蓝宝石在暗处也发亮，真好。
lines.en: The sapphire glows even in the dark; good.

lines.zh: 这根树干扛回去，能当门闩。
lines.en: This trunk will do as a door bar.

lines.zh: 我捡起矿工丢下的镐，拿去换。
lines.en: I pick up the miner's dropped pick to trade.

lines.zh: 东西不多，但我都收着。
lines.en: Not much here, but I keep all of it.

lines.zh: 你动了我的蘑菇堆，我看见了。
lines.en: You touched my mushroom pile; I saw.

lines.zh: 洞里的火把光一晃，我就知道有人。
lines.en: A torch flickers in the tunnel, and I know someone's here.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的石片，声音传得很远。
lines.en: The shale you broke carries far down the tunnel.

lines.zh: 山里的规矩：进洞的都要留下。
lines.en: Mountain rule: whoever enters the cave stays.

lines.zh: 我把斧子从肩上放下来。
lines.en: I lift the axe down off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退向洞口，那正是我要的方向。
lines.en: You back toward the mouth — exactly where I want you.

lines.zh: 这块地方我守了很多年。
lines.en: I've guarded this place for many years.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of iron; I don't like it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西归我了。
lines.en: Whatever you're holding is mine now.

lines.zh: 我迈一步，你就得跑十步。
lines.en: One step of mine and you must run ten.

lines.zh: 洞口就这么窄，你跑不出去。
lines.en: The mouth is narrow; you can't slip out.

lines.zh: 我挡在光那边，你背后是墙。
lines.en: I block the light; the wall is at your back.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我见多了。
lines.en: I've seen plenty of people raise shields like that.

lines.zh: 我等你先动，我比你有耐心。
lines.en: I wait for you to move; I'm more patient.

lines.zh: 地上那摊水会告诉你我在哪。
lines.en: The puddle on the floor tells you where I am.

lines.zh: 你退到钟乳石之间，路更窄了。
lines.en: You back among the stalactites; the way narrows.

lines.zh: 我抬起斧，洞顶的灰落下来。
lines.en: I raise my axe, and dust falls from the roof.

lines.zh: 你看我的脚，别看我的手。
lines.en: Watch my feet, not my hands.

lines.zh: 这一下我留了力，下一次不会。
lines.en: I held back this time; next time I won't.

lines.zh: 石像堆里，又要多一个了。
lines.en: There'll be one more in the pile of statues.

lines.zh: 石斧落下来，地面裂了一条缝。
lines.en: My stone axe comes down and the floor splits.

lines.zh: 树干横扫，你被扫到洞壁。
lines.en: My trunk sweeps wide and you hit the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的盾，往旁边一扯。
lines.en: I grab your shield and wrench it aside.

lines.zh: 石柱砸下去，你的脚边全是碎屑。
lines.en: The pillar slams down; chips fly around your feet.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住第二下。
lines.en: You can stop one blow, not the second.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞你，这招不需要斧。
lines.en: I hit you with my shoulder; no axe needed.

lines.zh: 斧背拍在你背上，你就站不住了。
lines.en: The axe's flat side hits your back and you fold.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后面，我把石头搬开。
lines.en: You hide behind a rock; I move the rock.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，洞里安静了。
lines.en: After that blow, the tunnel goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我把你按住，等你想清楚。
lines.en: I pin you down and wait for you to think clearly.

lines.zh: 雪原下面有洞，我从那儿上来。
lines.en: There's a hollow under the snowfield; I come up from it.

lines.zh: 洞里的石头认识我的手。
lines.en: The stones in this cave know my hands.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先摸到的是斧柄。
lines.en: I open my eyes and the first thing I touch is the axe handle.

lines.zh: 苔藓的味道，是我出生的味道。
lines.en: The smell of moss is the smell of my birth.

lines.zh: 森林的根须缠在我的脚上。
lines.en: Forest roots are tangled around my feet.

lines.zh: 从石缝里爬出来，我抖掉碎石。
lines.en: I climb out of the fissure and shake off the rubble.

lines.zh: 这一带的山，我一眼就认得。
lines.en: I know these mountains at a glance.

lines.zh: 地下的路很长，我慢慢走。
lines.en: The road below is long; I take it slowly.

lines.zh: 我出生时，斧子就在身边。
lines.en: When I was born, the axe was already beside me.

lines.zh: 洞口的风把我的气味吹远了。
lines.en: The draft at the mouth carries my scent far.

lines.zh: 我把第一块石头搬开，让路通。
lines.en: I move the first stone aside to open the way.

lines.zh: 雪地、山地、林子，我都住得惯。
lines.en: Snow, mountain, forest — I'm at home in all three.

lines.zh: 火燎到毛皮，焦味很重。
lines.en: Flame catches my fur, and the burnt smell is strong.

lines.zh: 从高处的矿道摔下，摔得很实。
lines.en: I fall from the upper mine shaft and land hard.

lines.zh: 地下河太深，我喝了好几口。
lines.en: The underground river runs deep; I swallowed plenty.

lines.zh: 爆炸推着我撞到洞壁上。
lines.en: The blast throws me against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 箭射在我身上，弹开了。
lines.en: The arrow strikes me and bounces off.

lines.zh: 紫光钻进毛皮，比火还难受。
lines.en: Violet light crawls through my fur, worse than fire.

lines.zh: 洞里蘑菇吃完了，肚子一直叫。
lines.en: The mushrooms are gone and my belly keeps growling.

lines.zh: 雷劈在洞口，我半边身子发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the cave mouth; half of me goes numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有石头可以扶。
lines.en: There's no stone here to hold on to.
